import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil
path = '/conf/config.xml'
shutil.copy(path, path + '.bak')
tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()

ifaces = root.find('interfaces')
optlanb = ET.SubElement(ifaces, 'optlanb')
ET.SubElement(optlanb, 'enable').text = '1'
ET.SubElement(optlanb, 'if').text = 'vtnet2'
ET.SubElement(optlanb, 'descr').text = 'LANB'
ET.SubElement(optlanb, 'ipaddr').text = '10.60.60.1'
ET.SubElement(optlanb, 'subnet').text = '24'
ET.SubElement(optlanb, 'ipaddrv6').text = 'none'
ET.SubElement(optlanb, 'blockbogons').text = '1'
ET.SubElement(optlanb, 'spoofmac').text = ''

filt = root.find('filter')
rule = ET.SubElement(filt, 'rule')
ET.SubElement(rule, 'type').text = 'pass'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'ipprotocol').text = 'inet'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'descr').text = 'antrieb: allow LANB to any'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'interface').text = 'optlanb'
src = ET.SubElement(rule, 'source')
ET.SubElement(src, 'network').text = 'optlanb'
dst = ET.SubElement(rule, 'destination')
ET.SubElement(dst, 'any').text = ''

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
print('config.xml updated')
PY
